_comment: REAPER's own track names, as it reports them over OSC.

this there was nothing to hold that against: the note in the tests
said so -- "nothing here reads .RPP files", and a wrong-but-well-
formed number would be caught by a person hearing the wrong channel
It turns out REAPER simply says. Point its OSC output at
tools/listen-to-reaper.py and it sends every track name. Recorded
